name: ot_qwen_tile_node

job.purpose: Native boundary stage correction: old HB4 output pads consume 69 ps TT after input-anchored TOREG flops and 36 um E-to-W wire. Dedicated output pin-flop split/retention plus output-only HB2 pad; input HB4 and 30 ps route hold margin unchanged. Arithmetic, register stages, outline/pins and production schedule unchanged. Remeasurement is diagnostic only; actual CTS/route/native audit required.

reroute_reason.fix: Replace the pre-2026-10-14 output boundary stage with HB2 output pads plus dedicated pin-flop split/retention; keep input HB4 pads, all RTL module edge contracts, 47.52 x 432 outline and exact pins. Preserved routed TT/FF parasitic remeasurement isolates 1027 HB4 output pads as the cause and predicts >30 ps launch recovery with FF output hold still positive.

pin_regs.reason: Re-kit of existing registered node ABI: RTL already has one capture stage on a/b/va/t_d/t_vd and one launch stage on y/vy/fault/t_out/t_vout. No extra pipeline stage is introduced; the measured defect is output HB4 pad delay in the old physical stage. Existing exact edge contracts are retained and native capture/launch are measured.
